tools.name: cite42_balance
tools.description: Check the remaining Cite42 balance in USD for the connected account. Free.

tools.name: cite42_search
tools.description: Run a query against AI models (OpenAI, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews, and ChatGPT itself on request) and return each model's answer along with the sources it cited. Google organic search positions are provided by cite42_keyword_rankings, not this AI-answer search. Priced per AI surface queried. Billed in USD (result field cite42Billing) to the user's prepaid Cite42 balance, and failed calls are free; exact prices from cite42_pricing (free). For plans over 20 calls or $5, estimate the cost and confirm with the user first.

query.description: The concise AI-search/market-research query to run against the selected models.

models.description: AI surfaces to query, each billed separately; pass a subset when the user names surfaces or wants a lower cost. Omit for the defaults (chatgpt = the OpenAI API, perplexity, gemini); fullSweep queries all five. google_ai_overview accepts queries up to 700 characters, the others 2000. chatgpt_app (ChatGPT itself, captured from its web interface) is opt-in and not in fullSweep; for every surface, list all six. It answers more slowly; if it does not answer in time, it has no result and is not charged.

fullSweep.description: Query the five standard AI surfaces (adds claude and google_ai_overview) at a higher cost. It leaves out chatgpt_app, so list all six in models for every surface. Ignored when models is given.

country.description: Optional ISO-2 country to measure from, e.g. "gb". Omit for each surface's default. Gemini has no country setting and ignores it.

language.description: Optional ISO-2 language for google_ai_overview and chatgpt_app, which read in it. Needs country; defaults to the country's main language.

Google organic search positions are provided by cite42_keyword_rankings, not this AI-answer measurement. Its requestId can be passed to cite42_recommendations when the user asks for improvement advice. Priced per AI surface queried. Billed in USD (result field cite42Billing) to the user's prepaid Cite42 balance, and failed calls are free; exact prices from cite42_pricing (free). tools.name: cite42_recommendations
tools.description: Page-level AI visibility recommendations, for when the user asks how to improve a page. With a saved result (requestId, trackerRunId or evidence) it reports on one measured prompt, charged only when the report includes page-comparison advice backed by quotes from inspected pages. Without one: url alone runs a free technical check of the page (robots.txt crawler access, indexing, rendering) and returns suggested buyer questions; url with query first runs a citations check, priced like cite42_citations, then the report. Prices are in cite42_pricing. Fetches the page, its robots.txt and up to two pages the AI surfaces cited, as returned HTML without JavaScript. No site-wide crawl, keyword advice or tracker activation. Billed in USD (result field cite42Billing) to the user's prepaid Cite42 balance, and failed calls are free; exact prices from cite42_pricing (free). For plans over 20 calls or $5, estimate the cost and confirm with the user first.

requestId.description: A requestId from your own successful Cite42 call within the last 30 days.

trackerRunId.description: A specific finished run of your own tracker within the last 30 days.

url.description: Your page that should answer the prompt. Without a saved result, url alone runs a free technical check; url with query runs a citations check first.

query.description: A buyer question. With a saved result it picks one measured prompt; without one it is the question measured.

models.description: AI surfaces for the citations check that runs without a saved result. Ignored with a saved result.

tools.name: cite42_keywords
tools.description: Classic keyword data for a seed term. Omit ideas when the user only needs that seed's monthly search volume, CPC, or competition. Set ideas:true only when the user asks for related, alternative, or long-tail suggestions from provider candidates. Not a multi-model AI-search query. The reply echoes requestedKeyword and carries status "exact" or "no_data"; when the seed has no search volume, any related term that does appears under alternatives — never treat an alternative's metrics as the requested keyword's. Billed by outcome: cheapest when the seed has no search volume, more when it has metrics, most with ideas:true. Billed in USD (result field cite42Billing) to the user's prepaid Cite42 balance, and failed calls are free; exact prices from cite42_pricing (free). For plans over 20 calls or $5, estimate the cost and confirm with the user first.

seed.description: Seed keyword or concise topic to fetch search volume, CPC, and competition for.

country.description: ISO-2 country code for localized metrics. Defaults to "us".

language.description: Optional ISO-2 language code. Defaults to the country's primary search language, so country "de" searches in German. Only multilingual markets accept an override: us (en, es), ca (en, fr), in (en, hi). Every other country has a single search language and rejects anything else.

ideas.description: Omit for volume, CPC, and competition on the seed only. Set true only for related, alternative, or long-tail keyword ideas.

For plans over 20 calls or $5, estimate the cost and confirm with the user first.

tools.name: cite42_tracker_create
tools.description: Create a draft daily, weekly or monthly tracker: one measurement — rankings, compare, citations, or sentiment applied to a list of prompts, with the brand, competitors and AI surfaces set once for all of them, or keyword_rankings applied to a list of keywords for one domain, country and device. Prompt lists can come from cite42_map_ai_prompts research. Creation does not start recurring calls. Managing trackers and reading reports is free; each run bills one call per prompt at the per-surface rates, or one check per keyword for keyword_rankings.

frequency.description: How often the tracker runs. daily needs no day field; weekly needs weekday; monthly needs monthday.

timezone.description: IANA timezone, for example Europe/London or America/New_York.

time.description: Local run time in 24-hour HH:mm format.

weekday.description: Weekly trackers only. Day of week, where 0 is Sunday and 6 is Saturday.

monthday.description: Monthly trackers only. Day of month 1-31; a value past the end of a shorter month runs on that month's last day, so 31 always means "month end".

primitive.description: What to measure: rankings (which brands get named), compare (the brand against named competitors), citations (which sources are cited) or sentiment (how one brand is described) run across AI surfaces for every prompt; keyword_rankings checks Google positions of a domain for every keyword. One measurement per tracker.

prompts.description: AI measurements: the prompts to track, up to 30. Each is billed as its own call on every run. Keep the wording stable so runs stay comparable, avoid dates, and do not repeat a prompt. Not used by keyword_rankings.

items.description: A prompt to run on every scheduled run.

brand.description: Required for compare and sentiment. Not used by rankings or citations.

competitors.description: Required for rankings (the brands to track, including your own) and compare (the rivals to rank against, up to 10). Not used by citations or sentiment.

url.description: Citations only: a URL to report on as cited or not cited.

models.description: AI surfaces to query for every prompt. Omit for the three defaults (chatgpt = the OpenAI API, perplexity, gemini), or list surfaces explicitly to set the recurring cost; chatgpt_app (ChatGPT itself, captured from its web interface) is opt-in. There is no fullSweep here: a saved tracker stores the exact list it was authorized for. Not used by keyword_rankings.

keyword.description: A search term as people type it into Google.

tools.name: cite42_tracker_activate
tools.description: Activate or resume recurring daily, weekly or monthly tool calls. maxCostMicroPerRun must equal the tracker's latest estimatedCostMicroPerRun; activation authorizes future billed calls until paused. The response includes the balance, the cost per run, and runsDryAt, the date the balance stops covering active trackers, and estimatedOverWeeklySpendLimit, true when active trackers are estimated to average more than the account's rolling seven-day spend limit; tell the user, because runs that reach it pause. When tracker emails are enabled, activation sends a setup summary and every completed run sends current results and suggested next steps, even when nothing changed. Activation is refused when the balance cannot cover the next run. instructions: Cite42 measures how AI answers mention brands and which sources they cite. ChatGPT itself is read from its web interface (models: chatgpt_app) and Google AI Overviews from live Google results; OpenAI (chatgpt), Claude, Gemini and Perplexity are queried through their official APIs with web search. Each result's measurement block states how every surface was reached. Cite42 also returns Google rankings, keyword volume, Google Trends, Reddit and YouTube data, and runs daily, weekly or monthly trackers. Calls are billed per use in USD from a prepaid balance, failed calls are free, and cite42_pricing lists every price for free.
